The primary objective of this project is to explore the potential association that smoking has on periodontal disease among adults. Specifically, it aims to look at whether teeth in the upper jaw are more prone to periodontal disease compared to the lower jaw. The data that will be used for this project comes from a 2011-12 NHANES database on the periodontal aspect of oral health.
